result: Result: order 102. The empty string equals empty text. With NULL, equality is unknown, so order 103 does not pass WHERE.
Result: order 101. Order 101 has known non-empty text. Order 103 is still unknown: <> does not turn missing text into non-empty text.
Result: order 101. NOT changes true to false and false to true. Unknown stays unknown, so this selects the same row as <>.

query: SELECT order_id FROM delivery_notesWHERE delivery_note IS NULL;
result: Result: order 103. IS NULL tests for the missing-value marker itself. Only order 103 passes; empty text on order 102 is a value.

query: SELECT order_id FROM delivery_notesWHERE delivery_note <> '' OR delivery_note IS NULL;
result: Result: orders 101 and 103. For order 103, unknown OR true is true. This policy includes missing notes alongside known non-empty ones.

query: SELECT order_id FROM delivery_notesWHERE delivery_note IS DISTINCT FROM '';
result: Result: orders 101 and 103. IS DISTINCT FROM treats NULL as comparable for this test. NULL differs from empty text, so orders 101 and 103 pass.
